gloss: browser; customer who looks without buying

definitions.gloss: browser; customer who looks without buying
definitions.explanation: A person who comes into a shop or stall to look at the goods or ask prices with no intention of buying. Said from the seller's side, with mild annoyance.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}やかし{客|きゃく}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷|ひ}やかし{客|きゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{売|う}れない→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: Lots of people just looking today, and nothing is selling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷|ひ}やかし{客|きゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}していた→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: The clerk explained the products politely even to people who were only browsing.

notes:
From ⟦{冷|ひ}やかし→冷やかす：11728_hiyakasu⟧, the noun of ⟦{冷|ひ}やかす→冷やかす：11728_hiyakasu⟧ in its sense of looking at goods without buying, plus ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (customer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷|ひ}やかし{客|きゃく}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧: nothing but browsers
- {冷|ひ}やかし{客|きゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相手|あいて}にする→相手にする：17364_aitenisuru⟧: to deal with browsers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ウィンドウショッピング→ウィンドウショッピング：30463_windoushoppingu⟧: window-shopping — the browser's own neutral word for the activity; {冷|ひ}やかし{客|きゃく} is the shopkeeper's view of the person
